# T4 search oracle on the full AC model

Stage A: 10000 Latin hypercube samples of the full envelope (seed 2007), shared by all rules. Stage B: differential evolution per topology (16 topologies), hard budget 2000 power flows per rule split evenly, population 15 initialised by LHS, no polishing, seed 7+topology index. Margin is positive iff the rule fires, in the units set by each atom's `scale`. Non-benign states are penalised, so every reported counterexample is benign by construction; the best counterexample is also re-solved with pandapower `runpp` (last column).
